commentary.text: 90+6' Tobias Stieler is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Tobias Stieler has issued a yellow card to Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach).
90+4' Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) tries to convince the referee to change his mind and receives a yellow card for dissent.
90+4' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Tobias Stieler's book.
90+2' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) reacts stupidly and the referee shows him a deserved red card!

44' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Tobias Stieler blows for a foul.

26' A crossfield pass from Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
24' Vini Souza (Wolfsburg) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Tobias Stieler no option but to blow his whistle.

18' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) launches a cross from the corner, but Moritz Nicolas is alert to thwart the effort.

15' Moritz Nicolas pulls off a great save to deny Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
14' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
14' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach). The ball goes out of play. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a corner kick.
13' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

12' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The referee points to the corner flag and B. Monchengladbach will take a corner.
11' Neat passing move from B. Monchengladbach in order to create new attacking opportunities.
10' B. Monchengladbach take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

8' A cross from a corner kick by B. Monchengladbach is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

7' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. It will be a corner kick for B. Monchengladbach.
